snippets.snippet_text: "I aim to integrate Substack with Patreon to obtain optimal results. I did it myself and helped many creators who enjoyed it and found it lucrative and more sustainable. After successfully using Patreon for over 6 years for creative, professional, and community-building purposes, I decided to share my experiences and observations in a book titled Patreon Mastery, which was published last month."
